notes: Per site-year, at Z17 and T95: gsl_lower = GSL if every QC-failing day (fallback QC < 0.25, or NA) is forced to count as BELOW threshold regardless of its own gap-filled GPP value; gsl_upper = GSL if every such day is forced ABOVE threshold; gsl_actual = the GSL actually reported elsewhere (uses each day's own real gap-filled value, including failing-QC days). spread = gsl_upper - gsl_lower, which is algebraically exactly n_fail_days (0-14 by rule 4's R2 N=14 construction) -- checked directly (stopifnot), not assumed. gsl_actual always lies in [gsl_lower, gsl_upper] (checked).
